description: Climber preferences and default grading scales stored on the user's repository

knownRouteScales.description: Route grading scales the user understands: grades in these scales are displayed as written

knownBoulderScales.description: Boulder grading scales the user understands: grades in these scales are displayed as written

knownViaFerrataScales.description: Via ferrata grading scales the user understands: grades in these scales are displayed as written

preferredRouteScale.description: Route scale used wherever a single scale is needed (aggregated charts, plots). Unset to infer from the user's location, falling back to French

preferredBoulderScale.description: Boulder scale used wherever a single scale is needed (aggregated charts, plots). Unset to infer from the user's location, falling back to Fontainebleau

preferredViaFerrataScale.description: Via ferrata scale used wherever a single scale is needed (aggregated charts, plots). Unset to infer from the user's location, falling back to Hüsler
